name: Blackfrost · Dreadwing Ascendant
prompt: Create a true grounded blackfrost wyvern facing west: two powerful hind legs, wing-knuckle forelimbs with planted talons, a deep connected cranium with two embedded frostfire eyes, swept membrane wings, crown-to-tail ice armor, and cinematic idle and roar motion.
description: A directly authored game-ready wyvern with deep semantic eye anatomy, consistently forward talons, articulated wing membranes and ice armor, two production animation clips, and a quantized Meshopt GLB compiled to one primitive.
